response.original_title: How to Add a Cabin to a Crystal Cruises Booking in 2026?
response.overview: [Official Refrence] How to Add a Cabin to a Crystal Cruises Booking in 2026?  To add a separate cabin or room to an active Crystal Cruises booking, you cannot do it online or through the mobile app; you must book a new stateroom and contact customer support or your travel agent to link the reservations +1(866) 254-7549 (US) or 44-120-420-8151. Steps to Add a Cabin Book a New Stateroom: Contact Crystal Cruises or your travel advisor to check current inventory and secure a separate, new cabin for your sailing.  Have Details Ready: Keep your original booking reference number, passenger details, and preferred stateroom categories available when calling Contact Numbers U.S. and UK : Call Crystal Cruises at +1-866-254-7549 or United Kingdom: Call +44-120-420-8151.
